name: Golden Temple Old City
description: The dense historic core surrounding the Golden Temple, filled with narrow lanes, bazaars and heritage buildings. Staying here means being minutes from the shrine and the langar, amid constant activity, street food and pilgrim crowds.
bestFor: Travellers wanting to walk to the Golden Temple and soak up old-city life

name: Ranjit Avenue
description: A planned, well-off residential and commercial area north of the center with wide roads, malls, cafes and better hotels. It offers a calmer, greener base with modern amenities while staying a short drive from the old city.
bestFor: Remote workers wanting reliable amenities, cafes and quieter modern lodging

name: Lawrence Road / Mall Road
description: A busy central corridor lined with restaurants, shops, banks and mid-range hotels. It balances proximity to the old city with more open streets, making it a practical, well-connected base with plenty of dining choices.
bestFor: Visitors wanting a central, well-connected base with shops and restaurants

name: Green Avenue
description: A quieter residential colony east of the center known for tree-lined streets, guesthouses and local eateries. It suits longer stays wanting a calmer, more homely environment while remaining a short auto-ride from major sights.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting a calm residential base near the city sights
